zh: 虽然下着雨，我们还是去散步了。
en: {Although|Though|Even though} it was raining, we still went for a walk.

zh: 虽然这家餐厅有点贵，但非常值得一去。
en: {Although|Though|While|Even though} the restaurant is a bit pricey, it's well worth a visit.

zh: 尽管他很累，他还是帮我修好了笔记本电脑。
en: {Even though|Although|Though} he was tired, he still helped me fix my laptop.

zh: 尽管她完全没有IT经验，她还是拿到了这份工作。
en: She got the job {even though|although|though} she had no experience in IT at all.

zh: 除非下雨，否则我们周六就烧烤。
en: We'll have a barbecue on Saturday {unless} it rains.

zh: 除非我叫你重启，否则不要重启服务器。
en: Don't restart the server {unless} I tell you to.

zh: 我爱喝咖啡，而我太太更喜欢喝茶。
en: I'm a coffee person, {whereas|while|but} my wife prefers tea.

zh: 旧系统备份要好几个小时，而新系统只要几分钟。
en: {Whereas|While} the old system took hours to back up, the new one takes minutes.

zh: 只要你周五前把车还回来，你就可以借我的车。
en: You can borrow my car {as long as|so long as|provided|provided that|if} you bring it back by Friday.

zh: 只要周五下午能休息，我不介意加班。
en: I don't mind working late {as long as|so long as|provided|provided that|if} I get Friday afternoon off.

zh: 带把伞吧，以防下雨。
en: Take an umbrella {in case} it rains.

zh: 我把密码记下来，以防忘记。
en: I'll write down the password {in case} I forget it.

zh: 为了不错过早班飞机，我定了闹钟。
en: I set an alarm {so that|so} I wouldn't miss the early flight.

zh: 你能大声一点吗？好让后排的人都能听到。
en: Could you speak a bit louder {so that|so} everyone at the back can hear you?

zh: 我一到机场就给你打电话。
en: I'll call you {as soon as|once|when} I get to the airport.

zh: 付款一到账，我们就给你发货。
en: {As soon as|Once|When} the payment goes through, we'll ship your order.

zh: 等我们到电影院的时候，电影已经开始了。
en: {By the time|When} we got to the cinema, the film had already started.

zh: 等你读到这封邮件的时候，我已经在去悉尼的飞机上了。
en: {By the time|When} you read this email, I'll be on the plane to Sydney.

zh: 水管工明天才能来。在这期间，我们先用楼上的洗手间吧。
en: The plumber can't come until tomorrow. {In the meantime|Meanwhile|Until then|For now}, let's use the bathroom upstairs.

zh: 你的新电脑下周到；在那之前，你可以先用这台备用的。
en: Your new laptop arrives next week; {in the meantime|meanwhile|until then|for now}, you can use this spare one.

zh: 一方面我想要大一点的房子，但另一方面我不想背更多的房贷。
en: On the one hand I'd love a bigger house, but on the other {hand} I don't want a bigger mortgage.

zh: 在家办公每天能省一个小时。但另一方面，我挺想念和同事聊天的。
en: Working from home saves me an hour a day. On the {other} hand, I miss chatting with the team.

zh: 航班晚点了三个小时。结果，我们没赶上转机。
en: The flight was delayed by three hours. As a {result|consequence}, we missed our connection.

zh: 他没有备份文件，结果丢了整整一周的工作成果。
en: He didn't back up his files and, {as a result|as a consequence|consequently}, lost a whole week's work.

zh: 这个项目暂停了，何时恢复另行通知。换句话说，别再花时间在上面了。
en: The project is on hold until further notice. In other {words}, don't spend any more time on it.

zh: 他说预算“还在审核中”。换句话说，这笔钱我们拿不到了。
en: He said the budget is still under review. {In other words}, we're not getting the money.

zh: 顺便问一下，你周末过得怎么样？
en: By the {way}, how was your weekend?

zh: 谢谢你的报告。哦，对了，你收到我关于周六的短信了吗？
en: Thanks for the report. Oh, {by the way|incidentally}, did you get my text about Saturday?

zh: 这款新手机很贵。话虽如此，它的相机确实很棒。
en: The new phone is very expensive. That {said}, the camera is amazing.

zh: 我不太喜欢露营。话虽这么说，上周末我玩得很开心。
en: I'm not a big fan of camping. {That said|Having said that|Even so|Still|However|Mind you}, I had a great time last weekend.

zh: 我们可以开车，也可以坐渡轮。不管哪种方式，都要一个小时左右。
en: We can drive or take the ferry. {Either way}, it takes about an hour.

zh: 也许他忘了，也许他只是太忙。不管怎样，他都欠你一个道歉。
en: Maybe he forgot, maybe he was just busy. Either {way}, he owes you an apology.

zh: 菜很好吃。不过，上菜非常慢。
en: The food was great. {However|That said}, the service was very slow.

zh: 我们最好现在就走，否则会赶不上公交车。
en: We'd better leave now, {otherwise|or|or else} we'll miss the bus.

zh: 米饭没有了，所以我改吃了面条。
en: There was no rice left, so I had noodles {instead}.

zh: 我们走路去咖啡馆吧，不要开车了。
en: Let's walk to the cafe {instead of|rather than} driving.

zh: 就算明天早上冷得要命，我也要去跑步。
en: I'm going for a run tomorrow morning {even if} it's freezing.

zh: 在这儿等着，直到我回来。
en: Wait here {until|till} I get back.

zh: 我去洗手间的时候，你能帮我看一下包吗？
en: Can you watch my bag {while} I go to the toilet?

zh: 既然你反正要去超市，能帮我带点牛奶吗？
en: {Since|As|Seeing as} you're going to the supermarket anyway, could you grab some milk?
